notes.title: Update v0.3.16
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27768987/8c6528bae04c1576d6bc5245fcaffdd90f143c76.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greetings, my friends! New update v0.3.16 is here![/h1]
List of changes:


[h1] Gameplay [/h1]
• Introduced "System of dynamic orders" on all maps.
• Added a new order "Driver". Purpose: to deliver the infantry to the front.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
• Fixed the distance of the layout of the field hospital (before the flag).
• Fixed error of the order timer.
• Fixed bugs related to orders.
• Fixed crates, canisters (life time added).
• Fixed minor bugs.
• Fixed the flight of grenades.
• The action menu has been fixed.

[h1] Other [/h1]
• After the death of the player, the camera appears on the Spawn point.
• After filling the lobby, the order starts automatically.
• Mosin's rifle and K98 now killing with one shot.
• The scatter is increased when firing with PPS.
• The model of med. tent has been increased (so that players can freely enter it).
• Reduced the time of displaying corpses on the map.
• When the account reaches -500 CP, the player excludes from the server automatically.
• The light filter is removed.
• Added 25% to the brightness of the sun.
• Fixed key maping.

notes.title: Update v0.3.14 «Dynamic Order System»
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27768987/80fb1da2ee15c6ae1b194ede178636ef48dff247.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greetings, my friends! New update v0.3.14 is here![/h1]

[h1] Gameplay [/h1]
• Added «Dynamic Order System». Now there is 8 orders are available:
- Artillery
- Tank
- Mortar
- Transport
- Messenger
- Medical
- Sniper
- Infantry
Now we are working on English-language localization.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
• Fixed a "dark" graphics.
• The shooting of all weapons has been calibrated.
• Corrected the behavior of vehicles during the movement.

[h1] Other [/h1]
• Removed all the maps except "16 km2".
• New animations for German soldiers.
• Damage to rifles increased by 20%.
• Removed the tent from the trucks.
• Dynamic day time shift removed.
• Added possibility of canisters to explode.
